title: feat: group usage by model or API key
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added Models and Keys tabs to the activity usage table, so users can compare Pollen spending or request counts by model or API key. The selected grouping persists in shared URLs, reloads, and browser Back/Forward navigation alongside existing filters. Key names remain consistent, duplicate names are distinguished, unknown models are included, and screen readers are told which column is active.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden workspace, Polli uses a retro terminal with two pixel tabs labeled 'MODELS' and 'KEYS' above little charts, while code-plants grow beside the desk. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny reading glasses; she is small-to-medium sized, sharing the frame with the terminal, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
